name: Online Retail II - cleaned, validated and AI-ready (UK gift shop sales 2009-2011)
description: Cleaned and validated version of the UCI Online Retail II sales data, produced by a Tableau Prep flow with Python Script steps. One row per unique sales line (fact_sales), separate tables for quarantined lines (with reason), cancellations and non-product lines (postage, fees), a product dimension with one description per product, monthly revenue per country, and AI-ready customer features (RFM scores and segments). Every row keeps its source sheet and the number of raw lines it represents (copies).
identifier: TO CONFIRM: DOI assigned by Zenodo after the group publishes the dataset

creator.name: Data Management group, SRH University of Applied Sciences Heidelberg - member names TO CONFIRM

creditText: Contains data from Online Retail II (Chen, 2012, UCI Machine Learning Repository, CC BY 4.0) and GeoNames (geonames.org, CC BY 4.0). Changed: de-duplicated, validated, split by quality status, enriched with country codes.
measurementTechnique: Sales export of the retailer (UCI); processed with Tableau Prep Builder 2026.2 and Python 3.12 Script steps (TabPy); see prep/online_retail_flow.tfl

distribution.description: 1,003,214 trusted sales lines, 26 columns, UTF-8, ISO 8601 dates
